items.title: NEE or CEG: Which Clean Energy Stock Is Better Positioned for Growth?
items.summary: NEE and CEG stand to benefit from rising clean energy demand, but stronger earnings growth, better profitability and cheaper valuation give the latter an edge.

items.title: 3 AI Infrastructure Stocks That Pay You While You Wait
items.summary: The AI selloff has hammered chip and power stocks, yet three companies powering the buildout keep raising payouts that earnings and cash flow cover many times over. The yields look tiny, so what makes these dividends worth the wait?

items.title: Constellation concludes 4.4GW natural gas-fired power plants sale
items.summary: The acquisition expands LS Power's presence in PJM, one of the largest wholesale electricity markets in the US.

items.title: How Investors May Respond To Constellation Energy Stock After Earnings Estimate Upgrades
items.summary: Constellation Energy has completed the sale of about 4.4 GW of largely natural gas generation in the PJM region to LS Power, meeting required divestitures tied to its earlier Calpine acquisition and reshaping its generation mix. The divestiture, together with stronger operating cash flow, rising earnings estimates and long term power contracts, tightens Constellation Energy’s focus on higher quality clean and contracted output rather than broad gas exposure. items.title: Vistra Has Slumped for a Year: Why Morgan Stanley Still Sees 82% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley cut its Vistra price target to $211 from $224 and kept its Overweight rating, which still points to 82% upside. Vistra fell on cheaper Texas power and an election that put data center growth in doubt, and Constellation Energy and NRG Energy are down sharply too, even though both held or raised guidance.

items.title: JPMorgan Sees S&P 500 At 8,200 In 2027 As AI Supercycle Remains Intact
items.summary: JPMorgan believes the recent unwinding of leveraged AI investments could extend the cycle rather than end it, saying investors are underestimating demand for AI computing capacity.

items.title: Vistra Underperforms Industry in the Past Year: Time to Buy or Wait?
items.summary: VST has plunged 31.2% in a year, but rising electricity demand, strong earnings growth prospects and a discounted valuation may support holding the stock.

items.title: State Street Utilities SPDR (XLU) Sells $32.8 Million of NextEra on Nov. 23
